strings.cmd_help: Usage: solstice [status]. Shows the current season and day. To hold a season, use the Season Override cheat in the settings.
strings.cmd_waiting: Solstice is waiting for this world's season.
strings.status_overheat_tip: Too many warm clothes for summer. Stamina and Eitr recover more slowly.
strings.cfg_visuals__world_tint_help: Solstice colors grass, leaves and the ground for the season on this client. Spring and summer stay green and fall turns leaves amber. Winter color follows Snow Cover. Local to this player. The server does not override it. Takes effect at once. Off restores the game's colors.
strings.cfg_visuals__snow_cover_help: In winter, Solstice covers Meadows, Black Forest, Swamp and Plains ground with the game's mountain snow, following the winter day. Grass thins and turns frosty, flowers drop out, and leaves take a light snow while trunks stay brown. Open ground stays a little under full mountain white. It also raises the game's own snow level on materials that already have one. Local to this player. The server does not override it. Solstice does not save snow onto buildings and does not add a snow mesh. Takes effect at once. Off restores the ground, the grass and the textures.
strings.cfg_visuals__frozen_water_help: On the winter days when shallow water freezes, Solstice tints the shallow color, and the top color and foam when the water has them, toward an icy blue. The water stays partly transparent, and the ripples are spaced out. Local to this player. The server does not override it. A missing property is left as it is. Solstice does not add ice you can walk on. Takes effect at once. Off restores the water.
strings.cfg_visuals__minimap_tint_help: Solstice tints the small map and the large map for the season. Terrain, pins and fog stay the game's. Local to this player. The server does not override it. Takes effect at once. Off restores the maps.
strings.cfg_visuals__season_indicator_help: Solstice shows the current season and day in a small plate under the compass. Local to this player. The server does not override it. The plate stays off the compass and the status effect row. Takes effect at once.
strings.cfg_visuals__season_icons_help: Solstice draws a small mark for the season on the season plate and on the season status. The marks are drawn by Solstice in the Meadworks colors. Local to this player. The server does not override it. Takes effect at once. Off removes the mark from the plate. Winter keeps the Solstice winter mark on the status so it stays visible on a bright sky. Other seasons use the game's status icon.
strings.cfg_visuals__heat_meter_help: Solstice shows a small meter of warm-clothes heat in a hot season. It fills while frost-resistant clothes are worn outdoors and empties indoors, in shelter, in cold weather, or after a cooling food. Two or more pieces is the overheat that slows stamina and Eitr recovery. Local to this player. The server does not override it. The meter stays off the compass, the status row, notices and the hotbar. Takes effect at once. A narrow window leaves the word off when it would be smaller than 8 pixels, and a window at least 1280 wide keeps the word.
strings.cfg_music__seasonal_music_help: Solstice plays one of the game's own music tracks for the season, such as a brighter plains or meadow track in summer and a quieter mountain or Deep North track in winter. Combat, bosses, locations, sailing, morning, evening and the home track are left alone. Local to this player. The server does not override it. Takes effect at once. Off returns to the game's music. A dedicated server does not play music.
strings.cfg_general__enabled_help: Off: no season effects and no seasonal weather; the world runs on the game's own rules. The season is still reported to other mods.
strings.cfg_protection__heat_protects_crops_help: On: crops near a fire (heat) do not die of cold in a winter that stops growth.
strings.cfg_protection__shield_generator_protect: On: places inside a shield generator dome are outside the seasonal effects, good and bad.
Shield Generator Protects In Winter Only
On: the dome protects in winter only. Off: it protects in every season.
strings.cfg_protection__winter_hardy_crops_help: Grown crop prefab names, separated by commas, whose plants live through a winter that stops growth. Plants that tolerate cold always do.
strings.cfg_protection__crops_perish_help: On: ripe crops on the control list can freeze and perish in a winter that stops growth. The host or server sets this for everyone. A crop that perishes drops its normal harvest at the crop. A crop that survives stays ripe to pick.
strings.cfg_protection__perish_from_day_help: The winter day a controlled crop starts freezing. Earlier days it is only out in the cold. The host or server sets this for everyone.
strings.cfg_protection__freeze_seconds_help: How many real seconds a controlled crop freezes before it either survives or perishes. Sleep and time skips do not shorten this grace period. The host or server sets this for everyone.
strings.cfg_protection__winter_harvest_chance_he: The chance, from 0 to 1, that a controlled crop stays ripe after it finishes freezing. The host or server sets this for everyone. 0 always perishes. 1 always stays ripe.
strings.cfg_protection__crops_to_control_help: Prefab names, separated by commas, of ripe crops that can freeze and perish. The host or server sets this for everyone.
strings.cfg_climate__season_status_help: On: the season's status effect applies outdoors, except in the Ashlands and the Deep North. The host or server sets this for everyone. A shield dome does not block it.
strings.cfg_climate__warm_clothes_overheat_help: On: two or more frost-resistant clothes in a hot season slow stamina and Eitr recovery, unless the player is indoors, sheltered, in cold weather or has eaten a cooling food. The host or server sets this for everyone.
strings.cfg_climate__cooling_foods_help: Food names or prefab names, separated by commas, that stop the warm-clothes overheat. The host or server sets this for everyone. The default is Eyescream.
strings.cfg_notices__season_message_help: A center message when a new season starts. Local to this player.
strings.cfg_cheats__season_override_help: Holds the world in one season for everyone, whatever the calendar says (Off lets the calendar run). Spring, Summer, Fall or Winter.
strings.cfg_calendar__days_in_spring_help: Length of spring in in-game days. The year is the four seasons in turn. The season already underway keeps its start day. A shorter length can end it on the next morning, and the new lengths apply to the seasons that follow.
strings.cfg_spring__plants_growth_multiplier_hel: How fast plants and crops grow and ripen in spring. 1 is normal; 0 stops growth.
strings.cfg_spring__beehive_production_multiplie: How fast beehives make honey in spring. 1 is normal; 0 stops them.
strings.cfg_spring__food_drain_multiplier_help: How fast eaten food runs out in spring. 1 is normal; below 1 food lasts longer.
strings.cfg_spring__stamina_drain_multiplier_hel: How much stamina your actions use in spring. 1 is normal; below 1 you tire more slowly.
strings.cfg_spring__fireplace_drain_multiplier_h: How fast fireplaces, braziers, smelters and cooking fires burn their fuel in spring. 1 is normal; above 1 they burn faster.
strings.cfg_spring__sap_collecting_speed_multipl: How fast sap extractors fill in spring. 1 is normal.
strings.cfg_spring__rested_buff_duration_multipl: How long the Rested effect lasts in spring. 1 is normal.
strings.cfg_spring__wind_intensity_multiplier_he: How strong the wind is in spring. 1 is normal.
strings.cfg_spring__rain_protection_help: On: rain does not wear down roofed or unroofed buildings in spring (snow replaces the rain).
